import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
env=os.environ['STATEWISE_PROJECT_ENV']
root=Path(os.environ['STATEWISE_ENV_ROOT'])
if not (root/env/'packages'/'vite.json').exists(): raise ModuleNotFoundError('vite')
Path('vite-success.json').write_text(json.dumps({'environment':env,'ok':True})+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
